error[L0103]: a for loop names its element binding, and `_` names nothing
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/for-discard-binding-names-the-counting-loops/program.ldn:3:9
  |
3 |     for _ in 0..<3 do
  |         ^
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/for-discard-binding-names-the-counting-loops/program.ldn:3:5
  |
3 |     for _ in 0..<3 do
  |     ^^^ this traversal
  = note: [1150]: a for loop binds each item it walks; a loop that only repeats is `loop` [1130] or `while` [1140] with a counter of its own, as `while left > 0 do` with `dec left` in its body
